title: agents-draft-eight-posts
universal_lens: The universal lens unifies these primitives as a stochastic state-transition manifold where expected value (xFP, EPA) defines the baseline potential energy, and realized outcomes define kinetic realization. The residual FPOE acts as a martingale difference sequence, capturing transient luck-layer deviations that inevitably mean-revert to zero under ergodic conditions.
gsi_mapping: GSI maps these operators via conformal prediction over play-by-play streams. We treat xFP/EPA as conditional expectations $E[Y|X]$ derived from historical priors. FPOE is modeled as a heteroscedastic noise term decomposed into structural efficiency and stochastic TD-luck, allowing rigorous uncertainty band construction for buy-low/sell-high signals.
gse_mapping: GSE utilizes these primitives for dynamic situational reasoning. Monte Carlo simulations project draft-pick probabilities across discrete game states, while scheme-adjusted Havoc/Threat ratings act as localized defensive/offensive friction coefficients. Hidden-yardage metrics quantify boundary-condition shifts in field position resulting from special teams and penalty topologies.

primitives.name: Fantasy Performance Over Expectation Decomposition
primitives.verbatim_quote: Posts a **Fantasy Football Trade Chart & Rankings** with **FPOE** (Fantasy Points Over Expectation = XFP - FPG on his chart — inverted sign: negative FPOE = OUTscoring expectation; James Cook 62.5 trade value, -3.1 FPOE = sell-high), **FP/S** (fantasy points per snap), buy/shop/sell trend coding.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: FPOE: Dimensionless (Fantasy Points deviation); XFP: Expected Fantasy Points (dimensionless); FPG: Fantasy Points Generated (dimensionless); FP/S: Fantasy Points per Snap (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes underlying xFP model accurately captures contextual baseline probability distributions; assumes FPOE exhibits mean-reverting properties over sufficient sample sizes.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down during extreme outlier events (e.g., catastrophic fumbles, unprecedented weather anomalies) or when sample size $N$ approaches zero, rendering the luck-layer decomposition statistically insignificant.

layer2.mapping: Maps directly to GSI's regression-to-mean engine. The operator isolates the stochastic component of player output, feeding the quadrant display logic to identify high-xFP / negative-FPOE buy-low candidates.
layer2.telemetry: Weekly FPOE mean-reversion rate and bootstrap uncertainty bands.

primitives.name: Draft-Pick Probability Monte Carlo Simulation
primitives.verbatim_quote: One-stat-one-visual: QB EPA/play **in vs out of pocket**; **NFL draft-pick probability Monte Carlo** (e.g., Bengals 59.1% pick 11 / 25.5% pick 12); niche counting stats (7 INTs on Jalin Hyatt targets = 9.6% of targets, worst since 2022).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: P(pick): Probability mass function over discrete draft slot indices; EPA/play: Expected Points Added per play (dimensionless expected points).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes team win probabilities can be accurately simulated via repeated stochastic sampling of remaining season schedules and current strength-of-schedule adjustments.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Singularities occur at the end of the regular season when variance collapses to zero, or if the simulation fails to account for sudden roster-decimating injuries altering team strength priors.

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's forward-looking state transition engine. It projects future discrete states (draft capital) based on current continuous performance metrics (EPA), providing a probabilistic roadmap for asset valuation.
layer2.telemetry: Simulation convergence speed and variance reduction across 100k iterations.

primitives.name: Scheme-Adjusted Havoc and Threat Ratings
primitives.verbatim_quote: Posts Field Vision **Havoc Ratings** (defense) / **Threat Ratings** (offense): per-player impact learned play-by-play from years of NFL PBP, expressed as 0–100 percentile *within position group, scheme-adjusted* (e.g., zone vs man CB splits).
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: HavocRating: Percentile rank [0, 100] (dimensionless); SchemeContext: Categorical variable (e.g., Zone, Man); Impact: Per-play contribution metric (dimensionless).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes machine learning models can successfully disentangle individual player agency from systemic scheme constraints using only play-by-play data without tracking coordinates.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Breaks down when facing novel, highly unbalanced schematic matchups not present in the training distribution, leading to miscalibrated percentile rankings.

layer2.mapping: Feeds GSI's 'Open Havoc' transparency layer. By stratifying impact by scheme, it provides a granular view of defensive friction, allowing GSE to adjust offensive line success probabilities dynamically.
layer2.telemetry: Correlation between Havoc Rating and subsequent EPA/play suppression.

primitives.name: Special Teams and Penalty Hidden-Yardage EPA
primitives.verbatim_quote: 49ers EPA plots: special-teams **EPA/play kickoff vs punt coverage**; **expected points from penalties on no-yardage plays**; kickoff-coverage opponent starting field position.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: ST_EPA: Expected Points Added from Special Teams (dimensionless); Pen_EPA: Expected Points gained/lost from penalties (dimensionless); Start_FP: Starting field position (yards from goal line).
primitives.assumptions: Assumes standard Expected Points models can be extended to non-offensive/non-defensive phases (special teams, dead-ball penalties) to capture latent value shifts.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Becomes noisy in garbage-time situations where strategic incentives diverge from pure point maximization (e.g., intentional grounding to stop clock).

layer2.mapping: Isomorphic to GSE's boundary condition evaluator. It quantifies how non-playing phase actions shift the initial conditions of the primary offensive Markov chain, revealing hidden leverage points.
layer2.telemetry: Variance of starting field position relative to league average following ST EPA events.

reasoning_traces.think:
The mathematical derivation begins by defining the fundamental state of an NFL game as a tuple $(S_t, \mathcal{C}_t)$, where $S_t$ represents the discrete field position and down/distance, and $\mathcal{C}_t$ encapsulates the continuous tactical context (scheme, personnel). The core primitive, FPOE, emerges as the residual $\epsilon_t = Y_t - E[Y_t | S_t, \mathcal{C}_t]$, where $Y_t$ is the realized fantasy point output. Under the assumption of rational market pricing and efficient aggregation, $\epsilon_t$ behaves as a martingale difference sequence, implying $E[\sum \epsilon_t] = 0$. This allows us to decompose $\epsilon_t$ into a persistent skill component and a transient luck component (e.g., xTD-luck). The Monte Carlo draft probability operator extends this by simulating the trajectory of $S_t$ over the remaining season horizon $T$, integrating the instantaneous EPA rates to derive a probability mass function over final standings. Similarly, the Scheme-Adjusted Havoc rating acts as a localized modifier to the transition matrix $P(S_{t+1} | S_t)$, effectively increasing the probability of negative EPA transitions for the offense. Finally, the Hidden-Yardage EPA quantifies the discontinuous jumps in the state space $S_t$ caused by special teams and penalties, which are often ignored in standard offensive-centric models but critically alter the boundary conditions for the subsequent drive. Together, these operators form a comprehensive stochastic calculus for American football, bridging micro-level play efficiency with macro-level seasonal outcomes.

Across Galaxy Sports Intelligence (GSI) and Galaxy Sports Engine (GSE), strict mathematical isomorphism separates immutable source invariants from downstream derived kernels. Whenever empirical estimates depend on finite-sample observation windows, James-Stein / Empirical-Bayes shrinkage pulls noisy displacement signals back toward hierarchical priors while censoring extreme displacements within +/- 0.35 log-odds. Weighted conformal calibration further ensures distribution-free finite-sample coverage even under covariate shift between historical training splits and live operational weeks. Crucially, zero-leakage chronological causality demands that every parameter, variance weight, and situational adjustment strictly precede the target event horizon, preventing forward leakage or post-hoc optimization bias. In multi-agent governance, each extracted primitive functions as an auditable signal family: the 288-bit cognitive context mask activates matching structural priors, spectral cluster orthogonalization eliminates collinear inflation across overlapping domain theories, and Jacobian cross-layer vetoes block double-counting when two mathematical lenses describe the same underlying dynamical mechanism from dual coordinate systems. Operational telemetry tracks both predictive skill (proper scoring rules such as Brier and logarithmic loss) and empirical interval coverage alongside regime-shift alarms whenever denominator assumptions (sample independence, homoscedasticity, or stationarity) fail in the observed data stream.
reasoning_traces.retrocausal_genealogy: These primitives trace their lineage to the foundational work of Bill James in baseball sabermetrics, specifically the concept of replacing raw counts with rate statistics and expected values. The direct ancestor is the development of DVOA (Defense-adjusted Value Over Average) by Football Outsiders, which introduced scheme and opponent adjustments. The modern iteration relies heavily on the Expected Points Added (EPA) framework popularized by Advanced NFL Stats and subsequently refined by the nflverse R package community, shifting the paradigm from descriptive box scores to prescriptive, context-aware marginal value analysis.
reasoning_traces.theory_of_mind: Modeling opposing agents requires treating team coaches and fantasy managers as bounded rational actors optimizing distinct objective functions. Coaches maximize EPA and win probability, often leading to risk-averse decision-making in critical game states (e.g., going for it on 4th down). Fantasy managers, conversely, optimize for weekly FPG, frequently ignoring EPA in favor of volume-based heuristics. The FPOE operator exploits this cognitive dissonance: when a player exhibits high xFP but low FPG (negative FPOE), the market undervalues them due to recency bias, creating a buy-low opportunity. Understanding these dual optimization landscapes allows our engine to predict market inefficiencies and strategic pivots.
reasoning_traces.cross_layer_veto: Anti-collinearity vetoes are crucial to prevent signal leakage between layers. For instance, FPOE must be strictly orthogonalized against opponent strength; otherwise, a defense playing poorly against a weak offense could falsely inflate a quarterback's efficiency rating. Similarly, the Monte Carlo draft simulations must veto any correlation between current EPA trends and future injury probabilities unless explicitly modeled, avoiding double-counting risk. The Hidden-Yardage EPA must also be isolated from standard offensive EPA to ensure that special teams brilliance does not artificially inflate an offense's perceived scheme-adjusted threat level, maintaining the purity of each primitive's diagnostic scope.
